text: Relevant authorities have stated that they will continue to increase investment and further improve the urban public transportation network system.
src: 有关部门表示将继续加大投入，进一步完善城市公共交通网络体系。

text: At the press conference, reporters learned that this collaborative project will cover more than 20 major cities across the country.
src: 记者从发布会上了解到，本次合作项目将覆盖全国20多个主要城市。

text: Experts point out that the digital economy is becoming a key driver and supporting force for promoting coordinated regional development.
src: 专家指出，数字经济正在成为推动区域协调发展的重要引擎和支撑力量。

text: The implementation of this policy will benefit tens of millions of families and significantly reduce the financial burden of healthcare expenses for the public.
src: 该政策的实施将惠及数千万家庭，显著减轻群众在医疗方面的支出负担。

text: As temperatures gradually rise, spring plowing and preparation work is being carried out in various regions, and the overall supply of agricultural inputs is sufficient.
src: 随着气温逐渐回升，各地春耕备耕工作陆续展开，农资供应总体充足。

text: According to the organizers, this year’s expo features eight exhibition halls, and the number of participating companies has reached a record high.
src: 主办方介绍，本届博览会共设八大展馆，参展企业数量创历史新高。

text: Data shows that new energy vehicle exports have increased significantly over the past year, accounting for nearly 30% of total automobile exports.
src: 数据显示，过去一年新能源汽车出口大幅增长，占汽车出口总量近三成。

text: The newly built sports center, with a capacity of 60,000 spectators, will become a new landmark building in the city.
src: 新建成的体育中心可容纳6万名观众，将成为城市新的地标性建筑。

text: The research team spent five years completing this project, and the results have been published in a leading international journal.
src: 研究团队历时5年完成了这项课题，成果已在国际权威期刊上发表。

text: The local government has implemented various measures to boost tourism spending, resulting in a significant year-on-year increase in the number of tourists received during the holiday period.
src: 当地政府多措并举促进旅游消费，假期接待游客量同比明显增长。

text: This exercise focused on testing the coordinated operational capabilities of the emergency command system under complex conditions.
src: 这次演习重点检验了应急指挥系统在复杂条件下的协同作战能力。

text: After three months of intensive construction, the renovation project for this old industrial area was successfully completed and passed the final inspection.
src: 经过3个月的紧张施工，这片老旧厂区改造工程顺利通过竣工验收。

text: The report argues that the transition to a green and low-carbon economy will create significant market opportunities for related industries.
src: 报告认为，绿色低碳转型将为相关产业带来巨大的市场空间和机遇。

text: The traffic management department reminds everyone that traffic volume on highways is high during holidays, so please plan your route carefully before you set out.
src: 交管部门提醒，节假日期间高速车流量大，出行前请合理规划路线。

text: This laboratory brings together a group of outstanding young scholars who have achieved numerous original breakthroughs in the field of artificial intelligence.
src: 该实验室聚集了一批优秀青年学者，在人工智能领域取得多项原创成果。

text: The meteorological observatory forecasts that the northern regions will experience strong winds and a drop in temperature over the next three days, with some areas also experiencing dust storms.
src: 气象台预计未来三天北方地区将出现大风降温天气，局地伴有沙尘。

text: Data from the business sector shows that the consumer market continues to recover, and the trend of integrating online and offline channels is becoming increasingly apparent.
src: 商务部门数据显示，消费市场持续回暖，线上线下融合趋势更加明显。

text: This tunnel, which runs through the mountains, is over 12 kilometers long, and its construction involved overcoming numerous technical challenges.
src: 这条穿越山脉的隧道全长超过12公里，建设过程中攻克了多项技术难题。

text: More than 200 infrared cameras have been installed within the protected area to monitor the activity patterns of wildlife.
src: 保护区内已安装200多个红外相机，用于监测野生动物的活动规律。

text: The education department stated that it will continue to expand access to high-quality educational resources this year and promote balanced development.
src: 教育部门表示，今年将继续扩大优质教育资源覆盖面，推进均衡发展。

text: The National Bureau of Statistics released the economic data for last month today.
src: 国家统计局今天发布了上月经济运行数据。

text: This space mission successfully completed all the planned experimental tasks.
src: 本次航天任务圆满完成全部预定实验项目。

text: The meteorological department advises citizens to take precautions against severe convective weather.
src: 气象部门提醒市民注意防范强对流天气。

text: The newly opened intercity railway will reduce the travel time between the two cities by half.
src: 新开通的城际铁路将两地车程缩短一半。

text: The expert team conducted a comprehensive assessment of the affected areas.
src: 专家组对受灾地区展开全面评估工作。

text: This technology company has achieved significant breakthroughs in overseas markets.
src: 这家科技公司在海外市场取得重大突破。

text: Preparations for winter heating are now complete.
src: 冬季供暖工作目前已经准备就绪。

text: The city government announced the launch of a new round of renovation plans for older residential areas.
src: 市政府宣布启动新一轮老旧小区改造计划。

text: Studies have shown that there is a positive correlation between the amount of green space in a city and the health of its residents.
src: 研究显示，城市绿地面积与居民健康正相关。

text: The preparations for the National Games have entered the final sprint phase.
src: 全运会筹备工作进入最后冲刺阶段。

text: Relevant departments are conducting a joint large-scale inspection of workplace safety.
src: 相关部门联合开展安全生产大检查。

text: The newly built museum will officially open to the public next month.
src: 新建成的博物馆将于下月正式接待观众。

text: This year, grain production is expected to reach a new record high.
src: 今年粮食产量有望再创历史新高。

text: This is the first time that footage of snow leopard activity has been captured in this protected area.
src: 该片保护区首次拍到雪豹活动影像。

text: The organizers expect that this year’s exhibition will attract over 100,000 visitors.
src: 主办方预计本届展会观众将超过10万人。

text: The medical team went deep into the mountainous region to provide free medical care to the villagers.
src: 医疗队深入山区为村民提供免费诊疗。

text: The opening of the new route has significantly reduced travel time for passengers.
src: 新航线开通后旅客出行时间大为缩短。

text: Relevant authorities have urged all regions to make thorough preparations for flood control.
src: 有关部门要求各地切实做好防汛准备。

text: The completion of the bridge’s main span marks a significant milestone in the project.
src: 大桥合龙标志着工程取得关键性进展。

text: The Employment Services Week for high school graduates kicked off today.
src: 高校毕业生就业服务周活动今天启动。

text: Most parts of the country are experiencing clear weather today.
src: 今天全国大部分地区晴朗。

text: The stock market closed with a slight increase today.
src: 股市今日收盘小幅上涨。

text: The typhoon is expected to make landfall in coastal areas tomorrow night.
src: 台风明晚登陆沿海地区。

text: The new subway line officially opened today.
src: 新地铁线路今天正式开通。

text: People flocked to the park to admire the flowers.
src: 市民纷纷前往公园赏花。

text: This year’s exhibition will last for five days.
src: 本届展会为期5天。

text: The conference issued an important statement.
src: 会议发布了重要声明。

text: Airport flights have returned to normal this morning.
src: 机场航班今晨恢复正常。

text: The new library will open to the public next week.
src: 新图书馆下周对外开放。

text: Heavy rain caused some roads to become flooded.
src: 暴雨导致部分道路积水。

text: The winning team returned triumphantly tonight.
src: 冠军队伍今晚凯旋归来。

text: The environmental protection department has launched a special inspection.
src: 环保部门启动专项检查。

text: The general price level has remained relatively stable.
src: 物价水平保持总体稳定。

text: The giant panda cub makes its first public appearance.
src: 大熊猫幼崽首次公开亮相。

text: The highway will be free to use for a limited time starting today.
src: 高速公路今起限时免费。

text: The opening ceremony of the art festival was packed with attendees.
src: 艺术节开幕式座无虚席。

text: Sales of new energy vehicles have reached a new high.
src: 新能源汽车销量再创新高。

text: The research team successfully arrived at the target area.
src: 科考队顺利抵达目标区域。

text: Registration for the city marathon begins today.
src: 城市马拉松报名今日启动。

text: The renovation project for the old district has been officially completed.
src: 老街区改造工程正式完工。

text: I had planned to go hiking this weekend, but the weather forecast says it will rain, so I’ll have to stay home and relax instead.
src: 我本来计划这个周末去爬山，但是看天气预报说有雨，只好改成在家休息了。

text: I went to that restaurant you mentioned last time, and I had to wait in line for almost an hour, but the food was really good.
src: 你上次说的那家餐厅我去了，排了快一个小时的队，不过味道确实不错。

text: He has been working at this company since he graduated from university, and after two years, he was finally promoted to department manager.
src: 他从大学毕业后就一直在这家公司工作，前两年终于升上了部门经理。

text: My child is in the second grade this year, and every day after school, they have to watch cartoons for half an hour before doing anything else.
src: 我们家孩子今年上小学二年级，每天放学回家都要先看半个小时动画片。

text: The temperature has dropped significantly these past couple of days, so remember to wear more layers when you go out, and don’t catch a cold again.
src: 这两天降温厉害，出门的时候记得多穿点衣服，别又感冒了。

text: I’ve been thinking about changing jobs recently, but given the current job market, it’s probably best to be cautious for now.
src: 我最近在考虑换工作，不过现在这个行情，还是先谨慎一点比较好。

text: Yesterday, I found a wallet on the subway and handed it over to the station staff, hoping the owner will come to claim it soon.
src: 昨天在地铁上捡到一个钱包，交给了车站的工作人员，希望失主早点领回去。

text: If you had left half an hour earlier, you definitely wouldn’t have gotten caught in the evening rush hour traffic.
src: 你要是早半个小时出发，肯定就不会赶上晚高峰堵车了。

text: My parents are coming to stay for a while next month, and I plan to redecorate the guest bedroom first.
src: 我爸妈下个月要来住一段时间，我打算先把次卧重新布置一下。

text: The rent is due this month, and the landlord said that the rent will increase by 200 yuan each month starting next quarter.
src: 这个月房租到期了，房东说下个季度每个月要涨200块钱。

text: At the class reunion last week, I almost didn’t recognize several of my classmates; time really flies.
src: 上周同学聚会，好几个人我差点都认不出来了，时间过得真快。

text: I couldn’t sleep last night and tossed and turned until I finally managed to fall asleep around 3 a.m.
src: 我昨天晚上失眠，翻来覆去到凌晨3点多才勉强睡着。

text: My washing machine has been in use for almost eight years, and lately it’s been malfunctioning frequently, so I’m planning to replace it with a new one.
src: 家里的洗衣机用了快八年了，最近老是出毛病，我打算换一台新的。

text: Send this video to the group chat so everyone can take a look; it’s quite interesting.
src: 你把这段视频发到群里，让大家都看看，挺有意思的。

text: We went to a fruit-picking farm in the suburbs with the whole family over the weekend, and the kids had a great time.
src: 周末我们全家去了趟郊区采摘园，孩子玩得特别开心。

text: I now wake up at 6 a.m. every morning to go for a run, and I’ve been doing this for three months now. I feel much more energetic.
src: 我现在每天早上6点起床跑步，坚持了3个月，感觉精神好多了。

text: The elevator in this building breaks down every few days, and the property management says they will arrange for someone to come and do a thorough inspection and repair next week.
src: 这栋楼的电梯三天两头坏，物业说下周安排人来彻底检修。

text: My colleague recommended a budgeting app, and after using it for a month, I found it quite convenient.
src: 我同事推荐了一款记账软件，用了一个月觉得还挺方便的。

text: Yesterday, I was passing by a shopping mall and saw that they were having a seasonal sale, so I couldn’t resist and bought two more shirts.
src: 昨天路过商场看到换季打折，忍不住又买了两件衬衫。

text: I’ve known him for over ten years. We were classmates in elementary school, and we’ve always been very close.
src: 我和他认识十几年了，从小学开始就是同桌，关系一直特别好。

text: I plan to go to the gym for an hour after work.
src: 我打算下班之后去健身房锻炼一个小时。

text: The tripe at this hot pot restaurant is exceptionally fresh and worth trying.
src: 这家火锅店的毛肚特别新鲜，值得一试。

text: If you’re feeling tired, you should go home and rest early.
src: 你要是觉得累，就早点回去休息吧。

text: The shoes I bought last week are very comfortable to wear.
src: 我上周买的那双鞋穿着特别舒服。

text: Let’s go for a walk in the countryside this weekend and relax.
src: 咱们周末去郊外走走，放松一下心情。

text: He worked overtime until midnight yesterday, so he definitely won’t be able to get up today.
src: 他昨天加班到半夜，今天肯定起不来。

text: Mom said that the tomatoes they grew at home are doing exceptionally well this year.
src: 妈妈说家里种的西红柿今年长得特别好。

text: Please print two copies of this document and give them to the front desk.
src: 你把这份文件打印两份交给前台。

text: I’ve been learning how to cook recently, and I’m making good progress.
src: 我最近在学做菜，进展还挺顺利的。

text: The ending of this movie was completely unexpected.
src: 这部电影的结局完全出乎我的意料。

text: I just started reading the book you recommended last time.
src: 你上次推荐的那本书，我刚开始看。

text: The road in front of our residential complex has finally been repaired.
src: 咱们小区门口的路终于修好了。

text: I’ve arranged to meet up with an old classmate for morning tea on Saturday.
src: 我约了老同学周六上午喝早茶。

text: Did you bring an umbrella?It’s raining quite heavily outside.
src: 你带伞了吗？外面雨下得挺大的。

text: The kids have been pestering me to go to the zoo for the past few days.
src: 孩子这几天总闹着要去动物园。

text: I tidied up my study, and now it’s much more spacious.
src: 我把书房收拾了一下，现在宽敞多了。

text: My phone bill this month is significantly higher than last month.
src: 这个月话费比上个月多了不少。

text: Guess who I ran into in the elevator today?
src: 你猜今天在电梯里遇到谁了？

text: The new bookstore that opened downstairs from the company has a great atmosphere.
src: 公司楼下新开的书店环境很不错。

text: I remember putting the keys in my bag.
src: 我记得把钥匙放在包里了呀。

text: Let’s go see a movie this weekend.
src: 周末我们去看电影吧。

text: Have you had dinner yet?
src: 你吃晚饭了没有？

text: This item of clothing is on sale.
src: 这件衣服打折呢。

text: I’m going to the supermarket this afternoon.
src: 我下午去趟超市。

text: It looks like it’s going to rain outside.
src: 外面好像要下雨了。

text: Bring me a cup of coffee.
src: 帮我带一杯咖啡。

text: There are a lot of people on the subway today.
src: 今天地铁人格外多。

text: What have you been up to lately?
src: 你最近忙什么呀？

text: The air conditioner in the room is broken.
src: 房间空调坏了。

text: Remember to remind me tomorrow.
src: 明天记得提醒我。

text: This store is closed on Wednesdays.
src: 这家店周三休息。

text: My phone is almost out of battery.
src: 我手机快没电了。

text: A new noodle shop has opened downstairs.
src: 楼下新开了家面馆。

text: Are you feeling any better from your cold?
src: 你感冒好点了吗？

text: Are you free on Friday night?
src: 周五晚上有空吗？

text: The package has been left at the front desk.
src: 快递放在前台了。

text: I got a new haircut.
src: 我换了新发型。

text: This dish is a bit spicy.
src: 这道菜有点辣。

text: Where did you go for fun over the weekend?
src: 你周末去哪玩了？

text: The car keys are in the drawer.
src: 车钥匙在抽屉里。

text: Modern voice assistants typically first convert audio into text using speech recognition technology, and then use language models to understand the user’s intent.
src: 现代语音助手通常先通过语音识别把声音转成文字，再用语言模型理解用户意图。

text: Training large language models requires thousands of graphics processing units to operate continuously for weeks, resulting in significant energy consumption and costs.
src: 训练大模型需要成千上万块图形处理器连续运转数周，能耗和成本都相当可观。

text: LiDAR technology can accurately reconstruct the three-dimensional structure of the surrounding environment by emitting laser beams and measuring the time it takes for the beams to reflect back.
src: 激光雷达通过发射激光束并测量反射时间，能够精确重建周围环境的三维结构。

text: An end-to-end speech translation system directly maps the audio of the source language to the text of the target language, thereby avoiding the accumulation of errors.
src: 端到端语音翻译系统直接把源语言音频映射为目标语言文本，避免了误差级联。

text: Federated learning allows multiple institutions to collaboratively train a global model without sharing their raw data.
src: 联邦学习允许多个机构在不共享原始数据的前提下，共同训练出一个全局模型。

text: The precision of semiconductor lithography processes has reached the nanometer level, and extreme ultraviolet lithography machines are a key piece of equipment in this process.
src: 半导体光刻工艺的精度已经进入纳米级别，极紫外光刻机是其中的关键设备。

text: Unmanned driving systems require real-time integration of multi-source information from cameras, millimeter-wave radar, and ultrasonic sensors.
src: 无人驾驶系统需要实时融合摄像头、毫米波雷达和超声波传感器的多源信息。

text: Speech enhancement algorithms aim to recover clean speech from noisy signals, and common methods include spectral subtraction and deep learning-based noise reduction.
src: 语音增强算法旨在从带噪信号中恢复干净语音，常见方法包括谱减和深度降噪。

text: Reverberation is caused by sound waves reflecting multiple times within a room, which significantly reduces the accuracy of far-field speech recognition.
src: 混响是声波在房间内多次反射形成的，会显著降低远场语音识别的准确率。

text: Neural machine translation has replaced traditional statistical methods, and the translation quality has approached human-level performance for many language pairs.
src: 神经机器翻译取代了传统的统计方法，翻译质量在许多语言对上已接近人类。

text: The emergent capabilities of large models refer to the sudden appearance of reasoning and generalization abilities after the number of parameters exceeds a certain threshold.
src: 大模型的涌现能力指参数规模超过某个阈值后突然出现的推理和泛化能力。

text: The chip design process includes several stages, such as front-end logic design, functional verification, physical layout, and tape-out verification.
src: 芯片设计流程包括前端逻辑设计、功能验证、物理布局和流片验证等环节。

text: Channel coding introduces redundant bits, enabling the receiver to detect and correct errors during transmission.
src: 信道编码通过引入冗余比特，使接收端能够检测并纠正传输中的错误。

text: The error rate of automatic speech recognition is already below 5% in quiet environments, but noisy environments still pose significant challenges.
src: 自动语音识别的错误率在安静环境下已低于5%，但噪声场景仍充满挑战。

text: Multimodal large models, capable of understanding text, images, and audio simultaneously, are considered a pathway towards general artificial intelligence.
src: 多模态大模型能够同时理解文字、图像和音频，被视为通向通用智能的路径。

text: Edge computing moves inference tasks to the end devices, thereby reducing latency and protecting user privacy.
src: 边缘计算把推理任务下沉到终端设备，从而降低延迟并保护用户隐私。

text: Digital twin technology creates dynamic models of physical entities in a virtual environment and is widely used in intelligent manufacturing.
src: 数字孪生技术在虚拟空间中构建物理实体的动态模型，广泛应用于智能制造。

text: Speech synthesis technology has now reached a point where it can generate natural-sounding speech that is almost indistinguishable from human speech, which is posing a challenge to research on speech synthesis detection.
src: 语音合成技术已能生成接近真人的自然语音，冲击合成语音检测的研究。

text: Image compression algorithms leverage the visual redundancy characteristics of the human eye to strike a balance between image quality and data rate.
src: 图像压缩算法利用人眼的视觉冗余特性，在质量与码率之间取得平衡。

text: Object detection models need to answer two questions simultaneously: what objects are present in the image, and where are they located.
src: 目标检测模型需要同时回答图像中有什么物体以及它们分别在哪里两个问题。

text: Deep learning models update their parameters using the backpropagation algorithm.
src: 深度学习模型通过反向传播算法更新参数。

text: Convolutional neural networks are particularly well-suited for processing image data.
src: 卷积神经网络特别适合处理图像数据。

text: The emergence of large language models has transformed the paradigm of natural language processing.
src: 大语言模型的出现，改变了自然语言处理范式。

text: Speech recognition systems typically consist of an acoustic model and a language model.
src: 语音识别系统通常包含声学模型和语言模型。

text: The transistor density of this processor has nearly doubled.
src: 这款处理器的晶体管密度提升了近一倍。

text: Quantum entanglement is one of the key resources in quantum computing.

text: 现代语音助手首先使用语音识别模型将语音转换为文本，然后利用大型语言模型来理解用户的意图。
src: Modern voice assistants first convert speech into text using recognition models, and then interpret user intent with large language models.

text: 训练大型模型需要数千个图形处理器持续运行数周，这会消耗大量的能源。
src: Training large models requires thousands of graphics processors running continuously for weeks, consuming enormous amounts of energy.

text: 激光雷达传感器发射激光束，并测量激光束的反射时间，从而重建出环境的精确三维地图。
src: Lidar sensors emit laser beams and measure the reflection time to reconstruct precise three-dimensional maps of the environment.

text: 端到端语音翻译技术将源语言的音频直接转换为目标语言的文本，从而避免了错误在多个环节中不断累积和传播。
src: End to end speech translation maps source language audio directly to target language text, avoiding error propagation through cascades.

text: 联邦学习允许多个机构在不共享原始数据的情况下，共同训练一个共享模型。
src: Federated learning allows multiple institutions to jointly train a shared model without ever exchanging their raw data.

text: 现代光刻技术能够实现纳米级的精度，而极紫外光刻机则代表了这项技术的最高水平。
src: Modern lithography operates at nanometer precision, and extreme ultraviolet machines represent the pinnacle of the technology.

text: 自动驾驶系统必须实时融合摄像头、雷达和激光雷达的信号，从而构建出可靠的路况模型。

text: 语音增强算法旨在通过各种方法，从包含噪声的语音信号中恢复出清晰的语音，这些方法包括频谱减法和深度神经网络等。
src: Speech enhancement algorithms aim to recover clean speech from noisy mixtures using methods from spectral subtraction to deep networks.

text: 当声波在房间的各个表面之间反复反射时，就会产生回声，而回声会显著降低远距离声源识别的准确性。

text: 神经机器翻译在很大程度上取代了统计方法，在许多语言对的翻译中，其质量已接近人工翻译的水平。

text: 当模型参数达到一定规模时，就会出现一些新的能力，包括推理能力和在特定语境下的学习能力。
src: Emergent abilities appear when model parameters exceed a certain scale, including reasoning and in-context learning.

text: 芯片设计流程包括逻辑综合、功能验证、物理布局和制造等多个阶段，整个过程需要耗费数月时间。
src: Chip design flows through logic synthesis, functional verification, physical layout, and fabrication over many months.

text: 信道编码会引入冗余比特，以便接收端能够检测并纠正传输过程中产生的错误。
src: Channel coding introduces redundant bits so that receivers can detect and correct errors introduced during transmission.

text: 在安静的环境下，语音识别的错误率已经降至5%以下，但噪音和口音仍然是需要克服的难题。
src: Speech recognition error rates have fallen below five percent in quiet conditions, yet noise and accents remain challenging.

text: 能够同时理解文本、图像和音频的多模态模型，被广泛认为是通往通用人工智能的一条途径。
src: Multimodal models that understand text, images, and audio together are widely seen as a path toward general intelligence.

text: 边缘计算将推理任务转移到本地设备上执行，从而降低延迟，并保护敏感数据的隐私。
src: Edge computing pushes inference workloads onto local devices, reducing latency and keeping sensitive data private.

text: 数字孪生技术构建了物理资产的动态虚拟副本，从而支持智能工厂中的预测性维护。
src: Digital twins build dynamic virtual replicas of physical assets, supporting predictive maintenance in smart factories.

text: 如今，语音合成技术可以生成非常自然的语音，这给语音合成音频的检测带来了新的挑战。
src: Speech synthesis can now generate highly natural voices, posing new challenges for synthetic audio detection.

text: 图像压缩算法利用人类视觉的局限性，在保证视觉质量的同时，降低数据传输所需的比特率。
src: Image compression algorithms exploit the limits of human vision to balance visual quality against bitrate.

text: 目标检测模型必须能够识别图像中出现的所有物体，并确定每个物体在图像中的具体位置。
src: Object detection models must answer both what objects appear in an image and where each one is located.

text: 深度学习模型通过反向传播和梯度下降法来更新其参数。
src: Deep learning models update their parameters through backpropagation and gradient descent.

text: 卷积神经网络在从图像中提取空间特征方面表现出色。
src: Convolutional neural networks excel at extracting spatial features from images.

text: 大型语言模型从根本上改变了自然语言处理领域。
src: Large language models have fundamentally changed the field of natural language processing.

text: 现代语音识别系统通常会将声学模型和语言模型结合起来使用。
